source_observations.finding: FinTM2 enforces finite stack-index type K, labels Lambda and internal states sigma. Its own alphabet finiteness field concerns input alphabet; MainResults independently requires every stack alphabet finite. TM2OutputsInTime instantiates EvalsToInTime with explicit initList/haltList, and TM2ComputableAux packages Boolean alphabet equivalences.

Stmt is an inductive finite syntax tree of push/peek/pop/load/branch/goto/halt. stepAux recurses within that tree; goto or halt ends a block. TM2.step runs one labelled block, not an arbitrary unbounded while-loop.
EvalsTo stores a natural step count and equality to repeated transition application. EvalsToInTime extends it with steps<=m, not merely unbounded reachability.

interpretive_inference: For one fixed machine with finite state/control/alphabets, primitive functions have finite-domain tables, and finitely many finite statement trees bound primitive stack operations per counted block by a machine-dependent constant. This is an elementary interpretation of the model, not a Lean certificate produced here. The exact target quantifiers place the MainTheorem machine before k and the input formula.
